title: Code and data associated with the RNAAS note "Unified Habitability Index (UHI) v5.2" (AAS83819)
description:
Companion code and data for the RNAAS research note by E. Viridis (manuscript AAS83819, under review at Research Notes of the AAS). This is the frozen v5.2.1 reproducibility package; v5.2.1 differs from v5.2 only in reference corrections and an expanded AI disclosure (no scientific changes).

v5.2.2 updates the manuscript files to the length-revised version resubmitted to RNAAS on 19 Nov 2026 (no changes to code, data, or results).

 

UHI is a probabilistic habitability-and-observability index: a Dirichlet-weighted geometric mean of seven sub-indices, evaluated by Monte Carlo (10,000 draws per planet, seed 42) over the NASA Exoplanet Archive pscomppars table. Planets are ranked by UHI_rank = P(UHI > 0) x median(UHI | UHI > 0).

 

Contents (single ZIP mirroring the GitHub release; see README.md inside):

  • data/: dated catalog snapshot pscomppars_2026-11-18 (CSV and Parquet; 6,470 rows). Source: NASA Exoplanet Archive (NASA/IPAC).
  • results/: full results for 6,112 scored planets (CSV and AAS machine-readable table .mrt, which lists every column with its units), 3-sigma variant, Earth/Venus/Mars control anchors and the runaway-greenhouse veto sweep. UHI and sub-indices are dimensionless (0-1); radius and mass in Earth units; instellation in Earth units.
  • tables/: summary tables and statistics (CSV, JSON, Markdown).
  • figures/: all figures (PDF and PNG).
  • src/, run_uhi_v52.py, notebooks/: Python code that regenerates everything from the snapshot (requirements.txt lists dependencies).
  • sens_out_v5/: Sobol/LHS sensitivity outputs.
  • manuscript/: LaTeX source (AASTeX 7) and PDF of the submitted note.

PHL Habitable Worlds Catalog data are not redistributed; the code downloads them at run time.
